title: feat: implement roadmap P1-P2 priorities — error codes, i18n, READMEs, debug mode, migration guide
body:
Implements concrete deliverables from the P1 (Developer Experience) and P2 (User Experience) roadmap priorities identified in the Feb 2026 audit.

### Error code system (`@object-ui/core`)
- `OBJUI-001` through `OBJUI-010` with message templates, fix suggestions, and doc URLs
- `ObjectUIError` base class + `SchemaError`, `RegistryError`, `ExpressionError`, `PluginError`, `FieldValidationError`
- `createError()` factory, `formatErrorMessage()` with dev-mode suggestions, `isObjectUIError()` guard
- `SchemaErrorBoundary` now shows error codes and actionable suggestions in dev mode

```ts
import { createError, formatErrorMessage } from '@object-ui/core';

const err = createError('OBJUI-001', { type: 'MyWidget' });
console.log(formatErrorMessage(err));
// [OBJUI-001] Unknown component type: "MyWidget"
// 💡 Suggestion: Ensure the component is registered via registry.register()...
// 📖 Docs: https://objectui.dev/docs/errors/OBJUI-001
```

### Debug mode (`OBJECTUI_DEBUG`)
- `debugLog(category, message, data)`, `debugTime/debugTimeEnd` — zero-overhead no-ops when disabled
- Schema resolution tracing and render timing wired into `SchemaRenderer`
- Enable via `globalThis.OBJECTUI_DEBUG = true` or `OBJECTUI_DEBUG=true` env var

### Console i18n completeness
- Integrated `@object-ui/i18n` into console app (`I18nProvider` in `main.tsx`)
- Migrated hardcoded strings in `LoadingScreen`, `KeyboardShortcutsDialog`, `CommandPalette` to `t()` calls
- Added `console.*` namespace keys to all 11 locale files (en, zh, de, fr, es, ja, ko, pt, ru, ar)
- No Chinese UI strings remain; all user-facing text goes through i18n

### Documentation
- **MIGRATION_GUIDE.md** — v2→v3 migration with before/after for all 5 breaking changes (was referenced in README but missing)
- **10 package READMEs** — auth, tenant, permissions, i18n, mobile, collaboration, plugin-ai, plugin-designer, plugin-workflow, plugin-report
- **Hello World example** — `examples/hello-world/` with minimal schema.json → UI demo

### ROADMAP updates
Checked off completed items in P1.1, P1.2, P1.3, P1.5, P2.1 sections.

### Tests
38 new tests (31 error codes + 7 debug utilities). 937 tests pass across core/react/i18n. Updated `KeyboardShortcuts.test.tsx` to mock the i18n hook.
